RUBBER DEALERS (AMENDMENT) BILL


3.27 p.m.

    The Minister for Finance (Dr Goh Keng Swee): Mr Speaker, Sir, I beg to move,

    Dr Goh Keng Swee: Sir, I do not intend to waste the valuable time of this House in answering the contemptible allegations of the Member for Anson. I have already explained, and I have quoted you as an authority, Mr Speaker, Sir, that the procedure adopted by the Government is quite constitutional and in keeping with the traditions of parliamentary democracy.

    Question put. "That on this Assembly proceeding to the Orders of the Day, the Rubber Dealers (Amendment) Bill he ordered to be read a third time."

    Mr David Marshall: Division, Sir
